title: Codex cold-resume token efficiency: raw artifacts vs Open Scaffold capsule
question: For a bounded paused-work resume decision, does an Open Scaffold compact resume capsule let Codex preserve decision quality while using at least 2x fewer reported total tokens than a naked raw-artifact prompt?

control.label: Naked Codex over raw paused-session artifacts

metrics.label: Median human-facing decision quality score
metrics.notes: Six deterministic reader-usability checks cover plain action, explanatory reasons, unambiguous resume pointer, clear acceptance/remaining-work status, complete next fields plus at least one traceable evidence ref, and a plain no-approval boundary.

metrics.label: Median Codex-reported total tokens
metrics.notes: Derived from Codex CLI input_tokens + output_tokens in turn.completed usage for three read-only replicates per arm.

metrics.label: Prompt payload bytes given to Codex
metrics.notes: Direct prompt payload size, not an inferred model-token count.

metrics.label: Median wall-clock seconds for Codex response
metrics.notes: Wall time includes local Codex CLI startup/plugin overhead on the measured machine.

metrics.label: Compiled Open Scaffold resume record available
metrics.notes: This is the mechanism difference: raw artifacts vs a compiled Open Scaffold resume capsule. It is not a claim that the model became smarter.

evidence_battery.claim: 3 read-only Codex replicates per arm preserved decision quality at 6/6 while reducing median Codex-reported total tokens by 4.330033x.
evidence_battery.boundary: One paused-work cold-resume decision on codex-cli exec / gpt-5.5; not a universal workload, model, or production-readiness claim.

evidence_battery.claim: The scaffolded arm uses a compact packet with explicit plan, objective, action, resume pointer, acceptance summary, reasons, next fields, evidence refs, and authority boundary.
evidence_battery.boundary: Packet-field contract for this fixture only; it does not define a universal resume schema or claim human-reviewer replication.

evidence_battery.claim: No blind human-reviewer replication is claimed for this Codex 2x fixture.
evidence_battery.boundary: The shipped quality score is deterministic and human-facing; a real human-reader replication needs separate preregistration, answer keys, blinded packets, and receipts.

evidence_battery.claim: No minimal-checklist, packet-only, or alternate-packet ablation is claimed by this fixture.
evidence_battery.boundary: Ablations are disclosure-only here and cannot support broad dominance; future ablation claims must ship their own committed receipts.

caveats: Bounded fixture proof only: one paused-work cold-resume decision, not all AI work or all repositories.
Codex CLI did not emit total_tokens directly in this environment; receipts record input/output splits and derive total as input_tokens + output_tokens.
The raw control prompt is intentionally a long paused-session artifact stream; the scaffolded arm is the compact packet compiled from those facts.
The quality score is deterministic and human-facing, but it is still a rubric over committed answers rather than a blind human-reader study.
Open Scaffold did not approve closeout, merge, publish, release, deployment, or compliance.
